author: /root personally
selection_basis: Preselected small public trace whose position is already illustrated in the paper; no raw values consulted
phase1: Fetch only selected development file and check deposited MD5 and byte count; also record SHA256.
Inspect headers, channel labels, units, timestamps, sample rates, missing values and duration before assigning a physical variable.
All selected-file arrays become development data. All other raw arrays stay unopened.
Do not infer center frequency, synchronization, lock-in filter, calibration, source phase convention or platform motion from arbitrary numerical defaults.
candidate_analysis: Conditional compact-test-function oscillator inversion: use measured complex receiver/source channels to eliminate homogeneous initial-state terms without fitting and subtracting a chosen exponential; preserve rank, noise and filter requirements. Derive equations before choosing estimators.
data_roles: Published force/phase plots, fitted normalization and quoted calibration are already exposed. Reserved raw files can provide procedural checks only, not an unseen theory prediction. No empirical validation claimed.
stop_rules: If source/receiver/time units cannot be registered, document the limit before any force fit.
Do not absorb unknown platform acceleration into a scalar force claim.
No per-environment freely chosen transfer can count as a derived common action.
